description: FREE lite product feed hygiene scan of a product feed URL (XML, CSV, or JSON — auto-detected). Runs the same 20 checks as audit_feed but returns top-line results only: 0-100 score, A-F grade, disapproval-risk level, detected format, item count, check counts, and the titles of the top gaps — item-level detail is capped (no per-check evidence, no offending items, no detailed fixes). Use this to triage whether a feed needs the full audit_feed report, or call audit_feed directly for the complete evidence-backed scan.

url.description: Product feed URL to scan (XML, CSV, or JSON), e.g. https://example-store.com/feed.xml

name: audit_feed_lite
